faq.title: FAQ - ChatLite
faq.lead: Frequently asked questions about ChatLite, covering features, privacy, open source, and technical details.
faq.q1: What is ChatLite and how can I use it?
faq.a1: ChatLite is a cross-platform messaging app with web chat, private conversations, groups and an AI assistant. Try the web app or a desktop or Android client. Client and server source code is publicly available.
faq.a2: ChatLite encrypts transport with TLS/QUIC. Messages are processed and stored on the server, with recovery of the last 7 days of history. End-to-end encryption is currently unavailable. Self-hosting lets you manage the service and data; it does not add end-to-end encryption.
faq.a3: Yes. The server repository provides Docker Compose configuration and deployment guides. Prepare the required databases, cache, message queue and service settings first. AI features also require a configured model service.
faq.a4: Clients are available for Windows (MSI), macOS (DMG), Linux (DEB) and Android (APK), alongside the web app. Real-time web chat requires browser WebTransport support. Use a client if your browser does not support it.
faq.q5: Will my chat history be lost?
faq.a5: Messages are stored on the server. A new device can recover the last 7 days of history; existing devices can also read locally stored messages. This does not mean a new device can recover all past history.
faq.q6: How does the AI assistant work?
faq.a6: The AI assistant supports message search, group summaries and streaming conversations. Availability depends on the connected model service, account permissions and usage limits.
faq.q7: Where can I find the ChatLite source code?
faq.a7: Client source is on GitHub and server source is on Gitee. Follow the source links on the homepage to inspect the implementation, read documentation or report an issue.
faq.q9: How do I register and start using the web app?
faq.a9: Open the web app from the home page, choose Register, enter your email and a password that meets the displayed rules, then enter the emailed code on the verification page. Existing users can sign in with their email or user ID. If the email is missing, check the address and spam folder, then wait for the resend countdown.
faq.q10: What should I check if the web app cannot connect?
faq.a10: Check your connection and browser support for WebTransport, and try updating your browser. If the network restricts QUIC/UDP, try another network or download a client. Wait for the cooldown when the page reports a connection rate limit; repeated sign-outs and sign-ins are unnecessary. For persistent issues, report the browser version and error in the source repository without passwords, verification codes or tokens.
faq.q8: How can I contact the author?
faq.a8: You can submit feedback via GitHub Issues or send an email to the author (the email is shown on the homepage donation panel).
